concept.material: burnished copper and dark weathered wood
concept.internal_detail: miniature brass bevel gears and sliding pistons
concept.button: a small brass push-stud at the narrow tip
concept.shell_mechanic: The biconical wooden spindle separates down its middle seam and the upper and lower halves hinge outward
concept.emerging_parts: Two folded metal wings and a hooked beak head
concept.signature_move: its ruby glass eyes light up red, and its hinged beak plates swing open and snap shut once with a sharp mechanical click
concept.turkish: red-tailed hawk: Kizil kuyruklu somek (Yuksekten ucan yirtici kus) — yuzlu cift konik ig, parlatilmis bakir ve koyu eskitilmis ahsap

concept.material: dark cast iron with inlaid copper wire
concept.internal_detail: nested brass gears and spring coils
concept.shell_mechanic: The smooth nephrite pebble splits cleanly along its central copper seam and the two halves slide apart horizontally
concept.emerging_parts: Two slender jointed legs and a long curved needle beak
concept.signature_move: its needle beak pivots down once on its hinge and taps against the metal palm with a sharp metallic click
concept.turkish: common wallcreeper: Duvar tırmanıcısı (Avrupa dağlarında yaşayan küçük kuş) — pürüzsüz oyulmuş nefrit çakıl taşı, bakır telli koyu dökme demir
